alignments.note: The waw is rendered additively as *also*.
*So* carries the lexeme of כֵן *thus*; the English fronting, not the Hebrew order, puts it before *also*.
Inverted ASV order; the pleonastic subject pronoun stays with the finite verb.
Construct noun cannot take the article, so the supplied *the* belongs to this unit.
*of* belongs to the nomen rectum; the intervening article is its own unit.
*door posts* renders the one lexeme מזוזה; head on the word carrying it.
*of* belongs to this nomen rectum of מזוזות.
עצי־שמן rendered attributively as *olive wood*, so no second *of*.
Compound preposition מֵאֵת fuses to the one English preposition *out of*, headed on the ablative מִן; splitting it with אֵת unrepresented remains defensible.
*part* expands the substantive; head on *fourth*, which carries the lexeme.
ASV supplies *of the wall*, marked as an addition; no Hebrew morpheme licenses it.
